scripts.check: pnpm check:managed-sdk && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @awaken/application-example typecheck && pnpm --filter @awaken/managed-session-projection typecheck && pnpm -C web typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @awaken/managed-sdk-oracle build && pnpm --filter @awaken/managed-session-projection build && pnpm --filter @awaken/application-example build && pnpm -C web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @awaken/managed-session-projection test && pnpm -C web test && pnpm test:e2e-process-policy && pnpm -C web test:e2e:runner && node scripts/generate-example-docs.mjs --check && pnpm --filter @awaken/application-example test
scripts.examples:check: node scripts/generate-example-docs.mjs --check && pnpm --filter @awaken/application-example test && pnpm --filter @awaken/application-example build
